Vietnam Hanoi & Sapa
Feb 2023 • Solo
I am glad to be flying back to Bangkok after spending 6 days in Hanoi & Sapa. Usually I do not hold such feelings after a short visit but this time, I felt Vietnam taxi drivers & coach/express bus operators should not treat visitors as sacred cow. As a tourist, we know we have to be charged abit more than locals but I do not like the idea of being slaughtered & scammed into paying much more than the locals. Some drivers are asking 3-5 times the actual fare amount. Thanks to Grab, we can check the prices as a guide but again on my first arrival day, the Grab driver scammed me off D40,000 for airport parking when the actual amt is D15,000. He also asked for cash instead of putting this into the charge card.
The express bus operated by SAO VIET is horrible. Pls avoid this operator. The bus just drop us after exiting the highway coming into Hanoi from Sapa. Apparently, this is about 12-15km away from the Old Quarters in another district. When we arrived, there were a heap of 'taxis' eagerly waiting for our business. They would hv charged anyway from D300k-600k for a ride to yr hotel in the old quarters. I did not fall to this scam. I walked towards AEON & paid only D134,000 by Grab to my hotel.
Visitors just be aware & exercise extreme cautions with these opportunistic ppl. Overall Vietnamese are nice & friendly ppl. 
 Time to fly. not sure if I will be back.
